title: GamesPlane: Augmented Reality Gamesman | EECS at UC Berkeley
content: GamesPlane: Augmented Reality Gamesman | EECS at UC Berkeley GamesPlane: Augmented Reality Gamesman Miller Hollinger EECS Department, University of California, Berkeley Technical Report No. UCB/EECS-2025-136 June 4, 2025 http://www2.eecs.berkeley.edu/Pubs/TechRpts/2025/EECS-2025-136.pdf In this report, I introduce GamesPlane, a system that uses augmented reality to overlay the pre-calculated colored value of moves for a player playing a physical two-person, complete-information board game. The values come from application programming interface (API) calls to our Gamesman system that has strongly solved the game. It provides 20 frames per second updates for boards of all shapes and sizes with near-100% accuracy. Finally, it is highly configurable, with tools and documentation provided for easy extensibility.
